description: This file provides functions related to upgrading and checking the platform's firmware images and partition layout, including functions for image validation, copying configuration, completing upgrade procedures, and writing images to device partitions. It is likely used in the upgrade process within an embedded Linux environment, specifically for sunxi devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and consistency of the image and partition layout before upgrading. It extracts the boot sector from the image, compares the partition tables, and prompts to abort if differences are found.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the partition specified in the upgrade process, mounting the device temporarily.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by writing images, U-Boot images, and partition data to the device, optionally saving partition layouts, and updating device UUIDs.
